title: SNS from C#
description: Use Amazon SNS for pub/sub notifications with the AWSSDK.SimpleNotificationService package.

data.text: Amazon SNS is a fully managed pub/sub messaging service. It fans out notifications to email, SMS, HTTP endpoints, Lambda, and SQS queues.

data.title: Publish a notification to an SNS topic
Subscribe an email and SQS queue
data.content: Subscribe multiple protocols and confirm delivery.

data.title: Message Filtering
data.text: Use SNS message filtering policies to send only relevant events to each subscriber. For example, only send high-priority alerts to SMS and all events to SQS.

data.title: Notify on order events
data.description: Publish order events to SNS and route them to email and SQS.
steps: Create an SNS topic for order events
Subscribe an email address and confirm it
Subscribe an SQS queue for downstream processing
Publish a test message from C#
Add a filter policy so only orders above $50 trigger email alerts
data.expectedOutcome: Messages arrive in the SQS queue and email notifications are sent for matching events.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: SNS fans out messages to many subscribers
Topics are the central hub for event distribution
Confirm subscriptions for email and SMS endpoints
Message filtering reduces noise for downstream consumers
data.takeaway: SNS turns isolated services into a coordinated system without tight coupling.
